item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 30/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler in the morning and dry during the day over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating gradually early next week, temperatures will rise slightly over Guangdong. Another replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. It will be bright with relatively large temperature difference between day and night over the region.

Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Dry with sunny intervals during the day. Slightly cooler in the morning.
